integrity: Exact all-dimensional proof given; bundled full enumeration \(d\le4\) and sampled checks \(\(d=5\),6\) are finite corroboration and are not infinite verification.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted Boolean-cube graphical zonotopes under their intrinsic standard Euclidean metric only; neither weighted graph edges, deformations, nor full vertex enumeration of low-dimensional center polytopes is covered.
title: A Walsh-spectral collapse of the incenter locus of Boolean-cube graphical zonotopes
